Rook includes Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT) 8.0.0.

OCCT is third-party software, Copyright (c) Open CASCADE SAS, licensed under the
GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 with the Open CASCADE exception.
The licence and the exception are installed beside this notice:

  LICENSE_LGPL_21.txt
  OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt

RookNative.rhp loads the following OCCT libraries from its plug-in folder at run
time. They were built from OCCT tag V8_0_0 with no known source modifications
(the build provenance is reconstructed; see SOURCE.OCCT.txt):

  TKernel.dll TKMath.dll TKG2d.dll TKG3d.dll TKGeomBase.dll TKGeomAlgo.dll
  TKBRep.dll TKTopAlgo.dll TKPrim.dll TKBO.dll TKShHealing.dll

You may replace these DLLs with your own build of a compatible OCCT version.
The corresponding source for the shipped DLLs is described in SOURCE.OCCT.txt.
